🔥 CloakBrowser | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Bypassing bot detection systems in web scraping and automation tasks.
✨ Key Features: • Source-level C++ patches for 87 browser fingerprints (canvas, WebGL, audio, etc.) • humanize=True flag for human-like mouse, keyboard, and scroll patterns • High scores on reCAPTCHA v3 and passes Cloudflare Turnstile, FingerprintJS, BrowserScan • Drop-in replacement for Playwright and Puppeteer with same API
📖 Summary: CloakBrowser is a stealthy Chromium browser designed to bypass bot detection systems. It functions as a drop-in replacement for Playwright and Puppeteer, offering source-level fingerprint patches to make automated browsers appear as normal users.
